title: Uncapped `count` loop in batchMint
description: count (line 187) is caller-controlled with no upper bound; the loop at lines 207-209 runs count times, each iteration making an external nftMinter.mint call. Only count == 0 is rejected (line 191); no maximum is enforced.
impact: Self-DoS only. A large count exhausts the block gas limit and reverts the caller's own atomic transaction (including the upfront pull). No shared queue, per-block accumulator, or other user's funds/liveness depend on this call -- no protocol or cross-user impact.
attackPath: The loop exceeds the block gas limit; the transaction reverts atomically and rolls back.
recommendation: Add an owner-settable maxBatchSize and require(count <= maxBatchSize), mirroring the existing count == 0 guard.
